$comment: Normative port contract header. Authority: docs/design-options.md D1/§7.1/§7.5. The engine refuses to operate when protocol_version differs from .seed/version (exit 10).

2.name: claim_not_granted
2.meaning: claim contention (task already claimed) or rejected_author lockout; distinguish via the error field

3.name: invalid_transition
3.meaning: transition not present in the D1 edge table, or verb applied in a state it is not legal in

5.name: backend_unavailable
5.meaning: backend cannot be reached (offline vs server backend); triggers configured fallback

6.name: fenced_out
6.meaning: worker verb presented a stale or missing claim token (reaped predecessor, rotated fence)

10.name: version_mismatch
10.meaning: port schema/protocol version mismatch between shim, spec files, and backend

64.name: usage
64.meaning: CLI usage error (EX_USAGE); never emitted as a port verb result
